item.title: Longhorns shoot lights out from long range again, blow out Mississippi State on senior night
item.description: The Longhorns buried a season-high 11 of 22 3-point shots and forced 28 turnovers in a 92-42 drubbing of Mississippi State at Moody Center. In a 93-62 win over Arkansas on Feb. 19, Texas canned 10 long-range buckets for what was a season-high at the time.

item.title: US outlasts Canada 2-1 in a high‑stakes fight for Olympic men’s hockey gold
item.description: Team USA claimed Olympic gold in men’s hockey with a hard-fought 2–1 victory over rival Canada, delivering a dramatic finish to one of the Games’ most anticipated matchups. The win marks a defining moment for the American squad and adds a new chapter to the storied cross-border rivalry.

item.title: Texas softball mercy-rules No. 16 Arizona, wins 12th straight
item.description: No. 3 Texas softball closed the DeMarini Invitational with another dominant win over No. 16 Arizona, using a 10-run third inning to secure a 12-2 mercy-rule victory and extend its winning streak to 12

item.title: Texas completes sweep of Michigan State with first shutout of the season
item.description: No. 3 Texas completed a sweep of Michigan State with a 4–0 shutout, fueled by Dylan Volantis’ nine‑strikeout performance over seven innings. The Longhorns improved to 7–0 with another dominant showing on the mound

item.title: Abbott urges Texans to 'stay alert' amid chaos between US, Mexican drug cartels
item.description: Gov. Greg Abbott is urging Texans to stay alert for federal travel warnings from the U.S. Department of State amid the ongoing chaos in Mexico following Sunday’s killing of infamous drug lord of Jalisco New Generation Cartel Nemesio ‘El Mencho’ Oseguera Cervantes.

item.description: With 116 medal events in total, KXAN is keeping track of how many medals each participating team has won.

item.description: We're mostly looking at a light freeze, so no need to drip your pipes, but protect people, pets and plants tonight. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: 'It took a team': One couples path through endometriosis, and the doctor who helped them find answers
item.description: For years, Lindsey Hollmann-Butz suspected something more than routine cramps was behind her difficult periods. She also suspected the condition could shadow her hopes of having a baby.

item.title: Central Texas fire departments adopt AI modeling tool to predict and mitigate wildfire spread
item.description: Several Central Texas fire departments have adopted a new wildfire risk modeling tool to help firefighters better prepare and mitigate wildfire threats.

item.title: Williamson County tests Rapid DNA technology with results in under 2 hours
item.description: Beginning this fall, the Williamson and Montgomery County Sheriff's Offices will begin entering DNA samples from some arrestees at their jail booking stations into the Rapid DNA system. DPS is already using the technology at its labs, but this is the first time it will be used at select county jails.
